problem_statement: Validating an Active or Pending Dataset accepts malformed TLV values that should be rejected. A dataset whose PAN ID is the broadcast value (0xffff), whose Extended PAN ID is all-zeros or all-ones, whose Mesh-Local Prefix is not a locally assigned ULA (fd00::/8) prefix, whose Network Name is empty or longer than 16 bytes, or whose Network Name contains an invalid UTF-8 sequence is reported as valid, when these inputs must cause the dataset validation to fail with an error. The dataset validation routine must reject these malformed values in addition to checking TLV lengths.
